short_description: BrycexD, a streamer in New Zealand (where GTA 6 unlocked first), says he reached the credits in 39 hours 38 minutes with no breaks (GamesRadar, PowerUp Gaming). IShowSpeed needed 52 h 31 min (Dexerto, Men's Journal). Not verified on a speedrun board yet. No story spoilers. Footage: official Rockstar media, original audio removed.

short.headline: IT WASN'T SPEED
short.text: The first person to finish GTA 6 wasn't IShowSpeed.
short.text_es: La primera persona en terminar GTA 6 no fue IShowSpeed.

short.headline: 39 HOURS, 38 MIN
short.text: It was BrycexD, a streamer in New Zealand, where the game unlocked first. He says he hit the credits in thirty nine hours and thirty eight minutes, with no breaks.
short.text_es: Fue BrycexD, un streamer de Nueva Zelanda, donde el juego se desbloqueó primero. Dice que llegó a los créditos en treinta y nueve horas y treinta y ocho minutos, sin descansos.

short.headline: SPEED: 52 HOURS
short.text: IShowSpeed needed fifty two and a half hours, live, without sleeping. That's almost thirteen hours slower.
short.text_es: IShowSpeed necesitó cincuenta y dos horas y media, en vivo, sin dormir. Casi trece horas más lento.
